```{r}
#| label: cvevents
cvevents <- function(tbl, when, what, where, descr) {

    command_start <- "\\cvevent"
    tbl[[where]] <- gsub("\n", " \\\\newline ", tbl[[where]])
    tbl[[descr]] <- gsub("\n", " \\\\newline ", tbl[[descr]])
    res <- paste0(
        command_start, "{", tbl[[when]], "}", 
        "{", tbl[[what]], "}",
        "{", tbl[[where]], "}",
        "{", tbl[[descr]], "}"
        )

    cat(res, sep = "\n\n\n")
}

cvproj <- function(tbl,what,role,items){
    command_start <- "\\cvproj"
    res <- paste0(
        command_start, "{", tbl[[what]], "}",
        "{", tbl[[role]], "}",
        "{", sapply(tbl[[items]], function(x)paste0(x,collapse = ", ")), "}"
    )

    cat(res, sep = "\n\n\n")
}
```

# Summary

Highly skilled researcher with expertise in ecological and evolutionary genomics, plant biology, climate change and bioinformatics. Experienced in analyzing large-scale genomic data, conducting climate change adaptation studies, and teaching advanced scientific concepts. Adept at both independent and collaborative research in academic and non-academic settings.
